name: How long does wall paneling installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does wall paneling installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of wall paneling installation varies based on the room size, the type of paneling material, and the complexity of the design. A simple shiplap installation in a small room might take a day or two, while intricate custom paneling in a larger space could extend to several days or even a week. Factors like wall preparation, cutting precision, and finishing touches all contribute to the overall timeline. For an accurate estimate, we recommend an on-site consultation to assess the specific details of your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on room size, paneling type, and design complexity, typically ranging from a few days for simple projects to a week for larger, custom designs.
